invalid_if: An option-pool position or an anti-dilution type is stated that the user did not choose
name: Option Pool and Anti-Dilution
title: Option Pool and Anti-Dilution

legal_basis.note: Issue of shares to employees under a scheme of employees' stock option, by special resolution

authoring_note: Both terms are choices that move value between founders and the investor, so neither has a default. An option pool counted before the investment dilutes only the existing shareholders; one created after dilutes everyone. Weighted-average and full-ratchet anti-dilution differ greatly in effect on a down round. If the user does not choose, the term sheet says the term is to be agreed.
d4_44: Rebuilt 9 Oct 2026. Non-binding provisions are drafted as proposals ('it is proposed that ... be'), never as obligations, so the wording agrees with the Status provision.
